objective: Measure one first physical microbatch forward, loss, and unscaled backward without an optimizer step or artifact write; determine whether finite unscaled gradients would overflow V201's default AMP initial scale or whether kernel runtime itself owns the stall.
decision_rule: If loss and unscaled gradients are finite but max(abs(gradient))*65536 exceeds fp16 maximum, authorize one replay with a preregistered safe initial GradScaler scale derived from the observed bound. If unscaled runtime itself projects beyond the campaign budget, record a runtime limit. Never create a checkpoint or optimizer update.
claim_boundary: Read-only runtime and numerical attribution only; no training, quality, or Phase 3 claim.
